There has been major problems with Spectrum/Charter/TWC/Roadrunner lately. Neither mail.twc.com (TWC's email servers) or mobile.charter.net (Spectrum and Charter's servers) appear to be online right now and may have been down for some time. From what we hear from their users, service has been intermittent for a while but it's gotten worse in the past week or few. It is not specifically a Thunderbird issue - it appears to affect most or all 3rd-party email clients, including Outlook, eMClient, etc. Spectrum's support usually (but not always!) won't admit to any problems, only saying that they only support webmail.

Here's a link to Spectrum's own user forum where you can see many discussions of the situation:

https://community.spectrum.net/categories/email-22

If you have time and patience you could contact Spectrum for status.

I have seen mention of a possible temporary workaround, which is to change the SMTP server to "mail.brighthouse.com". I can't verify that this works, or if it does that it won't quit working at any time, but it's easy enough to try and you can change it back to the existing name if it's not effective.

Otherwise, until they fix their servers your only recourse for now is to use their webmail. Or find another, more reliable email provider.
